summary_en: This Phase II trial tests stereotactic body radiation therapy (SBRT) and fluoroestradiol (FES) PET/CT imaging in patients with oligoprogressive, estrogen receptor positive metastatic breast cancer. SBRT is given in 3 or 5 treatment fractions within 3 weeks, and F-18 16 Alpha-Fluoroestradiol is given by IV, with FES PET/CT scans at 12 and 24 weeks. The main outcome is not stated; the study is Phase II.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase II prueba la radioterapia corporal estereotáxica (SBRT) y las imágenes PET/CT con fluoroestradiol (FES) en pacientes con cáncer de mama metastásico positivo para receptores de estrógeno y progresión limitada. La SBRT se administra en 3 o 5 fracciones durante 3 semanas, y el F-18 16 Alfa-Fluoroestradiol se administra por vía intravenosa, con exploraciones PET/CT con FES a las 12 y 24 semanas. El resultado principal no se indica en el registro; el estudio es de fase II.
who_for: Estrogen receptor positive metastatic breast cancer with progression in 1 to 4 lesions
ECOG performance status of 2 or lower
SBRT must be feasible for all progressing lesions
Able to read and understand English or Spanish for questionnaires
not_for: Has had one to three lines of systemic therapy for metastatic disease
Progression in more than 4 lesions, including current pleural effusion, ascites or lymphangitic lung spread
Intracranial disease progression or current leptomeningeal disease
